ModMetaData.name: Adaptive Hostiles
ModMetaData.author: Anxiety471
ModMetaData.description:
Raids that think.
Needs a decision-model key. With one, every hostile raid is commanded as one squad by an AI decision model, so raiders stop trickling in and start fighting like a team. Without a key the mod does nothing and raids stay vanilla.
- They gather, find the weakest way into your base and push the breach together: melee in front, ranged covering, a second group flanking when there is another opening. - Ranged raiders kite: they step out of your colonists' weapon range and shoot from inside their own. Melee swarm. Shield-belt wearers press in. - Colonists caught in the open are attacked directly. Raiders spread around a lone target from several angles. - Melee keep hitting turrets until they fall and dodge blasts. A building with one door gets a small group through it while the rest hold their own spots. - Raiders do not run away on their own. When the last colonist is dead they loot and leave as usual.
Raid timing is still your storyteller's. Enter your key and pick the decision model in Options > Mod settings: TypeSafe Jev (recommended), Anthropic or an OpenAI-compatible server.
Requires Harmony. Built for RimWorld 1.7. Please report problems on GitHub: Anxiety471/Adaptive-Hostiles.
